race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
race.verdict: Chesham Stakes runner-up ON JUST TERMS sets a clear standard and can make a winning comeback after a 5-month break. Selosse remains with potential on the back of his Curragh debut, with Drive On There completing the shortlist. ON JUST TERMS (USA) SELOSSE (IRE) DRIVE ON THERE (USA)
